nodes.name: Sklearn Gaussian Process Regression Preprocessing Helper Atoms
nodes.description: Deterministic fit-time validation and target preprocessing helpers used by GaussianProcessRegressor before optimization and linear algebra.

nodes.name: gp_regression_target_count
nodes.description: Count observed output targets from a regression target vector or matrix.

nodes.name: gp_regression_validate_n_targets
nodes.description: Validate an observed target count against a configured n_targets value.
nodes.type_signature: (observed_n_targets: int, n_targets: int | None = None) -> int

nodes.name: gp_regression_target_statistics
nodes.description: Compute target means and positive scales used by GaussianProcessRegressor fit.
nodes.type_signature: (y: NDArray[np.float64], normalize_y: bool = False) -> tuple[float | NDArray[np.float64], float | NDArray[np.float64]]

nodes.name: gp_regression_normalize_targets
nodes.description: Normalize regression targets with supplied GP fit mean and scale statistics.
nodes.type_signature: (y: NDArray[np.float64], y_train_mean: float | NDArray[np.float64], y_train_std: float | NDArray[np.float64]) -> NDArray[np.float64]

nodes.name: gp_regression_resolve_alpha
nodes.description: Resolve scalar or vector alpha noise values to the form used by GaussianProcessRegressor.
nodes.type_signature: (alpha: float | NDArray[np.float64], n_samples: int) -> float | NDArray[np.float64]
